mechanism_log: The system has a clean modular structure: Y3 is controlled ONLY by X1 and X3 (both positive, linear). Y4 is controlled mainly by X2 (+) and X4 (+), with weak negative X6 and negligible X1. Y1 is influenced by all 6 inputs: X2, X4, X6 are strong positive drivers (~0.33-0.39 gradient); X3 is moderate positive (~0.21); X5 is positive but saturates around X5≈0.5; X1 is weakly negative/nonmonotonic. Y2 is driven by X1 (+0.19, bad), X3 (-0.18, good), X6 (+0.09, bad), X2 (+0.09, bad), and X4 (-0.05, slightly good). X3 is the only input that is universally beneficial (increases Y1, decreases Y2, increases Y3). The key trade-off is between Y1/Y4 (which both want high X2, X4) and Y2 (which wants low X1, high X3). X6 creates a Y1 vs Y4 conflict.

The system has highly nonlinear, interaction-dominated causal structure. Y1 is driven by a MASSIVE X2*X4 multiplicative synergy (Y1 jumps from 0.27 to 0.88 when both are high), plus X6 (positive, ~0.3 gradient), with X1 exhibiting a 3-way interaction (negative at center but +0.86 at high X2*X4). X3 is positive but saturates at high levels. X5 has a threshold at ~0.5 then saturates. Y2 is driven by X1 (+0.19-0.22, bad), X3 (-0.18, good), X2 (+0.09-0.13, bad); X6 shows a SIGN REVERSAL on Y2 (positive at center, NEGATIVE at high X2*X4). Y3 depends ONLY on X1*X3 in a multiplicative (not additive) relationship; Y3≥0.4 requires ~X1≥0.25 with X3=1.0. Y4 is driven by X2*X4 synergy plus X1 (positive at high X2*X4), with X6 negative (~-0.08). The main Pareto trade-offs: (1) X2 level trades Y1+Y4 vs Y2; (2) X6 level trades Y1 vs Y4; (3) X1 level trades Y1+Y4 vs Y2 (at high X2*X4) and provides Y3 constraint. Best: Y1=1.122, Y2=0.062, Y4=0.313.
